sentences.en: This is the first time I've ever recruited a cook.
sentences.zh: 这是我第一次招募厨师。

sentences.en: Sami had a better chance of getting recruited at Walmart.
sentences.zh: 萨米在沃尔玛被招募的可能性更大。

sentences.en: Did the bequest cover the cost of recruiting a professor?
sentences.zh: 这笔遗产是否涵盖了聘请教授的费用？

senses.zh: 招聘；吸引(新成员) - 吸收某人为新成员 -
招募，征募(新兵) - 恢复健康，恢复体力

mnemonic: 词根记忆：re（重新）+cruit（=cre，增长）→使部队成长壮大→招募（新兵）
